overview.description: The GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF (ATC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is actively managed, investing in a laddered portfolio of single-stock autocallable options referencing the price of Coinbase Global, Inc. (NASDAQ: COIN) ATC was launched on May 12, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
